label: About
title: About Freeware Engine Collision
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 309 recent saved-signal files and 268 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around @h100envy: 5 repos that replace a 5-person game dev studio. All free. All open source. The... and s&box editor, plus 7 more. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Freeware Engine Collision: Bright abstract game-space surface, composition archetype: game-space surface, camera plate grammar: ultra-wide violent crop. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against left torn white sticker shell with black outline, two embedded thumbnail slits inside the sticker, and central black knot aperture with visible cutaway windows.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
